design_description: A bright pink jersey with a sharp, modern geometric treatment. The body uses several tone-on-tone pink shades, forming large angular and faceted shapes concentrated toward the lower half. Black accents provide strong contrast through the shoulder piping, sleeve cuffs and curved side panels, giving the shirt a more structured silhouette. The front remains relatively clean, leaving space for the crest, number and central graphic. The back continues the pink base with large black name and number, framed naturally by the black side detailing. Overall, it's a bold, playful and modern design, balancing the vibrant pink palette with crisp black elements.
